services.desc: This class is perfect for absolute beginners! And you will achieve all this in just ONE day! Wow! We will pre-bake the cakes for you and make buttercream so you can get to the super fun decorating part. This cake is instructed by one of our very talented chefs. What a great way to spend a day! The best part: you will bring home a cake topped with the most beautiful decorations and covered in luxurious buttercream. It will be the most delicious and gorgeous cake you ever set your eyes on. All ingredients and equipment, including transport boxes for your cake course are provided, you do not need to bring anything with you. quotes.author: Paula Keating-Jones
quotes.text: Instructors were pleasant Instructors were pleasant. Class was informative. Wish they had some finished croissants for us to taste. Online add on options for wine, beer, cocktail, etc were present but were not offered options in person. Missed opportunity not offering day of, in my opinion, to make extra money.

quotes.author: Ivy K
quotes.text: Chiara is the best! We had such a lovely experience making Tiramisu with the assistance of chef Chiara! She created such a welcoming, interactive, and fun environment for my group and I, while clearly teaching us the steps to making such a delicious dessert! Thank you Chiara!

quotes.author: Hailey Miller
quotes.text: Cake decorating The class was a bit simplistic. Disappointing that we didn’t get to make our own snowflakes. The piping tip seemed a bit excessive size wise for decorating. Not many techniques taught.

quotes.author: Sean
quotes.text: Chocolate Masterclass Level 2 Today I took the Masterclass Level 2 led by Inci and it was a great experience. I enjoyed learning how to make chocolate bars and Ganache treats from scratch. Inci made the process easy and fun and my family all enjoyed the fruits of my labour's. I highly recommend taking the class!!

quotes.author: Elizabeth Kerr
quotes.text: Great class Mikayla was an engaging and knowledgeable instructor.

quotes.author: Lynda Kim
quotes.text: Yummy brioche cinnamon buns I took the cinnamon bun class at Le Dolci and had a wonderful experience.Chef Juan is so patient and an excellent teacher, guiding us expertly through the kneading process and providing great tips and tricks along the way. Love that the ingredients are portioned out, the dough is proofed and everything is ready to go so that we don't need to spend an entire day in the kitchen! We baked the buns at home and all loved the texture of the finished buns. They were much lighter than the bready type you regularly get, had a very nice consistency and plenty of filling.

quotes.author: Bill&Mary
quotes.text: Gnocchi Megan did a great job. Fun class, Yummy results

quotes.author: Emily Dychtenberg
quotes.text: I have been to many le dolci classes before and I typically leave feeling like I have learned something new, which was unfortunately not the case with this class. The instructor did provide some guidance, but some more formal instructions regarding how to decorate the cakes would have been appreciated. Eg: Providing photos or templates of different lambeth cakes, providing guidance regarding which types of icing patterns would work together, etc. For the price of these classes, I unfortunately don't think that my experience was consistent with previous classes.

quotes.author: Joginder Gill
quotes.text: The best week ever! I just completed the 5-day baking course at Le Dolci in Toronto and I can’t say enough good things about it! From the moment we started, time flew by — a true sign of how much fun I was having. Our instructor, Chef Vanessa, was absolutely lovely. She was patient, kind, and brought such a warm, sweet energy to the entire experience. You could tell she genuinely cared about helping each of us grow, no matter our starting point. What made the course so special was the mix of people — from total beginners who had never baked before to more seasoned bakers looking to fine-tune their skills. No matter your level, it felt completely relaxed and judgement-free.
